data.name: AP1_002
data.value: Everytime I walk past the guild I get like this...

data.name: AP1_003
data.value: It's hard not to feel down whenever it comes into my mind...

data.name: AP1_004
data.value: I want to become an adventurer so badly,[pause=10] but...

data.name: AP1_006
data.value: Well,[pause=10] dwelling on it isn't going to do anything but make me feel worse.

data.name: AP1_007
data.value: Exploring the forest should help take my mind off it.

data.name: AP1_008
data.value: Oh![pause=0] I almost forgot!

data.name: AP1_009
data.value: I can't let {0} see me go into the forest.

data.name: AP1_010
data.value: Last time he caught me I got an earful about how dangerous it is...

data.name: AP1_011
data.value: But I've been there plenty of times and nothing bad's ever happened.

data.name: AP1_012
data.value: That old coot is always overexaggerating...[br]Something like that could never be right next to town.

data.name: AP1_013
data.value: Besides,[pause=10] it's too much fun exploring in there to pass up anyway!

data.name: AP1_014
data.value: I am going to need to sneak around though.[pause=0] I don't want {0} seeing me.

data.name: AP1_015
data.value: I need to stick to the trees so he won't spot me.

data.name: AP1_016
data.value: Looks like he didn't notice.[pause=0] Now I won't have to hear him later...

data.name: AP1_017
data.value: I need to head on into {0} before he looks my way.

data.name: AP1_019
data.value: I've explored here a bunch of times before.[pause=0] It's usually pretty uneventful...

data.name: AP1_020
data.value: ...Odds are that'll be the case again...

data.name: AP1_021
data.value: But who knows?[pause=0] In a mystery dungeon,[pause=10] you never know what you might find!

data.name: AP1_022
data.value: Maybe this time it'll be different?

data.name: AP1_023
data.value: Only one way to find out!

data.name: AP1_024
data.value: Ugh... That was rough.

data.name: AP1_025
data.value: I got knocked out,[pause=10] so the dungeon spat me back at the entrance...

data.name: AP1_026
data.value: Exploring {0} can be difficult for me sometimes.

data.name: AP1_027
data.value: Alright.[pause=0] I think I'm ready to give it another go.

data.name: AP1_028
data.value: I'm sure I can make it through this time!

data.name: AP1_029
data.value: Looks like we made it out of the forest.

data.name: AP1_030
data.value: For someone who claims to be a human,[pause=10] you were pretty impressive in that dungeon,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: AP1_031
data.value: If I didn't know any better,[pause=10] I'd say you've done this before,[pause=10] hehe!

data.name: AP1_032
data.value: Um...[pause=0] This isn't really the place to talk...[pause=0] Can you come with me?

data.name: AP1_033
data.value: Thank you.[pause=0] Follow me!
